subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Greater, Less, or Equal
objective: Compare whole numbers by place value.
introduction: Milo is weighing two baskets of fruit! Help him compare 4,210 and 4,201.

vocabulary.definition: To look at two numbers and tell which is greater, less, or equal.
A symbol or word that tells how many, like 4,210.
What a digit is worth by its position.

items.prompt: Milo is comparing two number cards. Which statement about comparing numbers is true?

options.text: Compare digits from the greatest place to the ones place.

items.explanation: Start at the greatest place and compare each digit until one is different, then continue to the next place if they are the same.

items.prompt: Milo is comparing two number cards. Which statement correctly compares 4,210 and 4,201?
items.explanation: Both numbers have 4 thousands and 2 hundreds, but 4,210 has 1 ten while 4,201 has 0 tens. So 4,210 > 4,201.

items.prompt: Milo is comparing two number cards. Which is NOT a good way to compare numbers?
items.explanation: Looking only at the ones digit can trick you: 4,210 > 4,201 even though 0 < 1. Compare from the greatest place.

items.prompt: Milo is comparing two number cards. Which comparison sentence is true?
items.explanation: 5,640 has 6 hundreds while 5,460 has 4 hundreds, so 5,640 is greater than 5,460.

items.prompt: Milo is comparing two number cards. Which comparison between 2,999 and 3,000 is correct?
items.explanation: 2,999 has 2 thousands while 3,000 has 3 thousands. Since 2,000 is less than 3,000, 2,999 < 3,000.
